tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind panels. Dark is the core mark's ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, dialogs: anything a resource is rendered on.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Table header rows, Turtle source blocks, the shell's navigation rail.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around panels. Decorative only: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, quiet buttons and checkboxes. 3:1 or more on surface and ground in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and values on ground, surface, surface-sunk, layer and every *-soft fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, relative times on ground, surface and surface-sunk. 5.8:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, the primary button, the selected navigation item, the focus ring. Silt blue from the core mark. Text on surface, ground and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (primary button). Dark text in the dark theme because the accent lightens there.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid ring, offset 2px, on every focusable element. 6:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: layer
tokens.usage: Fill of a position stamp and of the selected table row: the log's own colour.

tokens.name: layer-ink
tokens.usage: Position numbers and commit ids on layer.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy state words and marks: open, ready, writer, within lag. Text on surface and ok-soft.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a healthy state badge.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Attention state words and marks: lagging, rebuilding, behind, the drift note. Text on surface and warn-soft.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an attention badge and of a drift notice.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Failure state words and marks: failed, superseded, not ready, a problem's status code, the danger button. Text on surface and critical-soft.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a failure badge and of a problem panel's header.

tokens.name: past
tokens.usage: Text and stripes of the as-of banner: a view pinned to a historical position. Text on past-soft and surface.

tokens.name: past-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the as-of banner.

tokens.name: term-iri
tokens.usage: IRI terms in chips, triples and graph nodes: an IRI is something to follow, so it takes the link colour. Text on surface, ground and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Asserted edges in a graph view and the frame of a triple-term chip. 3:1 on surface and ground.

tokens.name: edge-inferred
tokens.usage: Inferred edges, drawn dashed, and the dashed underline of an inferred predicate. Never the only sign: the word inferred goes with it.

tokens.name: added
tokens.usage: Assertions in a delta, a diff or a graph overlay: the + glyph and its count. Text on surface, surface-sunk and added-soft. Not a state colour: never use ok here.

tokens.name: added-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an added row or chip.

tokens.name: removed
tokens.usage: Retractions in a delta, a diff or a graph overlay: the − glyph, its count, struck-through terms. Text on surface, surface-sunk and removed-soft. Not a failure: never use critical here.

tokens.name: removed-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a removed row or chip.

families.mono: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen: the resource's name.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The dataset is open and its writer is this instance.
styles.usage: All running text, table cells and control labels.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: A row's identifying cell, a dialog's named effect.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary lines under a value, help text, relative times.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels in key-value lists and table headers; set uppercase in CSS, written in sentence case in the source.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The one number a panel is about: head position, lag. Tabular figures.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Positions, IRIs, request ids, Turtle and TriG source, problem types.

styles.name: code-small
styles.usage: Ids inside dense table cells and stamps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a mark and its word; inside badges vertically.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Table cell padding block; gap within a control group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding inline; gap between key-value rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; page gutter at phone width.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between panels; page gutter on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a page title; dialog padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, position stamps, inputs, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Only the live-tail indicator and the core mark's silhouette.

shadow.note: Panels sit on rules, not shadows. The only shadow is an overlay's.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Confirmation dialogs and menus above the page.
